g.title: J_OBC_ADCS
g.text: OBC board: PD12 SCL, PD13 SDA; timer pins TBD

g.title: J_EPS_ADCS
g.text: EPS board: SW4 ADCS 3V3, 0.5 A trip

g.title: J_MTQ
g.text: ADCS board, x3 (X, Y, Z): DRV8833 AOUT1/AOUT2 or BOUT1/BOUT2

g.title: W6C
g.text: x3, twisted; coil current about 100 mA (ADCS-I002)

g.title: J_SS
g.text: ADCS board, x6: to OPA333 TIA input (schematic S6)

g.title: W6D
g.text: x6, twisted and shielded: photocurrent is microamps; shield to AGND at the ADCS end only
